propositions: Reconcile_one function duplication between sync and S3 doctor targeted by this ticket was eliminated by Gerrit 1665, which replaced the doctor's worktree merge with merge-tree/commit-tree engine
Sync and S3 doctor hold contradictory policies on unrelated histories: sync refuses when store carries events to prevent grafting, while doctor unions unconditionally
Sync cannot adopt a ref-only merge because its consumers read ticket events from worktree files, while doctor deliberately never touches worktree
Sync must never raise exceptions while doctor must raise to enable push path abandonment, making unified failure policy impossible
A behaviour-preserving shared reconcile_one function cannot be extracted due to opposed policies on unrelated histories, merge mechanism, and failure handling
